observations.reasoning: Sourced on 2026-07-27, transversal pass over the population indicator. Population on 1 January 2025: 9539502 inhabitants, recorded as 9.54 million. Eurostat dataset demo_pjan, Population on 1 January by age and sex, read through the dissemination API on 2026-07-27, dataset last updated 2026-07-09. Total population, both sexes, all ages, which is exactly what this indicator's denominator asks for. Read as one table covering every country in the record, so no value here is derived from a neighbour: each is that country's own row. The previous value was an opening estimate produced with no source and no research.

Re-read on 2026-07-27 under the ruling of the same day. Source: the directory of the Magyar Bábművészek Szövetsége, which separates the houses carrying the designation awarded under the 2008 performing arts act — the one that brings central budget support — from those without it. Thirteen carry it. Twelve are counted: Budapest Bábszínház, Bóbita, Ciróka, Miskolci Csodamalom, Griff, Harlekin, Kabóca, Kövér Béla, Mesebolt, Napsugár, Vaskakas, Vojtina. All twelve are freestanding organisations whose vocation is puppetry, hence twelve house and no stage. The thirteenth is set aside, and the record departs here from its own source, which is worth stating plainly rather than burying. The Kolibri Gyermek- és Ifjúsági Színház was founded in 1992 by the Budapest municipal assembly when the State Puppet Theatre split in two, its company came largely from puppeteers, and the puppet profession's own association lists it among the designated puppet houses. Against that: its own pages describe a children's and youth theatre running three venues — Jókai tér, Kolibri Fészek and Kolibri Pince — whose repertoire carries puppet, spoken, musical, movement and opera work together, with no puppet stage or puppet ensemble named separately anywhere in it. The ruling counts a permanent puppetry unit, and Kolibri does not hold one: it holds a single mixed company of which puppetry is one form. It falls out on vocation, not on structure — the same test that admits three Czech stages excludes it. The ruling has cost the Hungarian count half a point, from 12.5 to 12, and it has removed the dispute. What survives from earlier the same day is the real finding: the opening estimate of 6 to 8 was wrong by a factor of two, and the association directory is a membership list rather than the statutory register, so twelve is a floor.

observations.reasoning: Web check of 2026-07-27, in the country's own language, revisited the same day after the ownership ruling. The value stays at 1 and the dispute is lifted, but not the source caveat, and the two must not be confused. What was disputed was a method question: the denominator required a course backed by a state institution, and since 1 September 2020 the University of Theatre and Film Arts in Budapest is no longer a public institution but is run by a private foundation, a transfer that prompted a prolonged conflict over academic autonomy. That question is now answered for the whole series: ownership is not a criterion, a state-recognised award is. The university remains Hungary's national theatre and film school and its qualifications remain state-recognised, so it counts, and the status returns to open. Confidence stays at estimated, for a reason that has nothing to do with the ruling. The institution's own site refuses automated reading and did so again today on two further routes, szfe.hu and felveteli.szfe.hu, both 403; the state admissions portal felvi.hu answered 503. Every route to a first-party or state reading has now failed twice, in two separate passes. The recorded source stays an encyclopaedic entry, which establishes the puppet actor specialism from 1995 and the puppet director specialism from 2008-09 but is not the institution and is not the State. Upgrading to sourced would mean calling an encyclopaedia a state register. To be closed by a route that is neither: the Oktatási Hivatal register of accredited programmes, or direct contact with the university.

establishments.name: Színház- és Filmművészeti Egyetem (SZFE)
establishments.award: Puppet actor specialism since 1995, puppet director specialism since 2008-09
establishments.description: Hungary's national theatre and film university, teaching puppetry for thirty years. Transferred from state ownership to a private foundation in September 2020, which blocked the count until the ruling of 2026-07-27 made the recognition of the award, not the ownership of the institution, the test. It counts. What is still missing is a first-party source: the university's site refuses automated reading.
